key_highlights: ASX ends volatile week higher despite intraday rate-hike-driven selloff; Qantas lifts while Wesfarmers and Sigma slump
Housing market under severe stress: auction sentiment deteriorating, 'perfect storm' warnings, and housing inflation pressuring RBA policy
Venezuela oil deal (Trump administration) reshaping global energy supply; Chevron and SLB positioning for exposure
Pilbara mining activity surges; Gateway Resources adds 7km gold trend in WA; ASX small-caps X2M, Discovery Alaska, Metal Hawk, Bapcor lead weekly gains
Australia imposes 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres; Hanson pushes coal over renewables without cost detail
Consumer trends: surging weight-loss drug demand, EV uptake accelerating, 'dupe' brand preference growing

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with elevated volatility; rate-hike headlines and housing data will drive intraday swings. Mining and gold provide relative strength. Banks under pressure from credit-quality fears. 1–3 month range: ^AXJO 8,200–8,600.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA navigates housing inflation without triggering a property correction. Venezuela oil supply and data-centre capex provide global growth support. Domestic consumer shift to value brands caps earnings upside for staples. Key risk: housing 'perfect storm' materialising.
